summary: Iteration 6 testing completed for DCLIC Informatique iPad Terminal Sync feature. Backend: 50/50 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All iPad sync features working correctly including PC→iPad assignment, auto-navigation, signature flow, auto-return to /ipad, and iPad status indicator.
passed_tests: BACKEND GET /api/ipad/current: returns {reparation_id: null, assigned_at: null, kiosk: true} initially
BACKEND GET /api/ipad/current: reflects assigned reparation after POST /assign
BACKEND POST /api/ipad/assign: succeeds with valid reparation_id
BACKEND POST /api/ipad/assign: returns 404 for invalid reparation_id
BACKEND POST /api/ipad/assign: kiosk=false works correctly
BACKEND POST /api/ipad/release: clears reparation_id and assigned_at
BACKEND PUT /api/ipad/heartbeat: updates last_heartbeat_at timestamp
BACKEND GET /api/ipad/status: returns online=true after recent heartbeat (<15s)
BACKEND GET /api/ipad/status: returns online=false when no recent heartbeat (>15s)
BACKEND GET /api/ipad/status: includes assignment info (reparation_id, assigned_at, kiosk)
BACKEND POST /api/reparations/{id}/signature: auto-releases iPad if that reparation was assigned
BACKEND POST /api/reparations/{id}/signature: does not affect iPad assigned to different reparation
BACKEND GET /api/reparations/{id}/public: returns safe data for signature page
FRONTEND /reparations: iPad status indicator in header shows 'iPad hors ligne' (gray) or 'iPad en ligne' (green pulse)
FRONTEND /reparations: Each repair card has 3 buttons - 'Envoyer sur l'iPad' (blue Tablet), 'Ouvrir ici' (green), Lock (kiosk)
FRONTEND /reparations: Clicking 'Envoyer sur l'iPad' calls POST /api/ipad/assign and shows toast 'Fiche envoyée sur l'iPad. Le client va pouvoir signer.'
FRONTEND /ipad: Displays DCLIC INFORMATIQUE title, tracking input, 'Passer en mode technicien' link
FRONTEND /ipad: Status footer shows clock and online indicator (green pulse when connected)
FRONTEND /ipad: Polls /api/ipad/current every 3 seconds
FRONTEND /ipad: Sends heartbeat every 8 seconds
FRONTEND /ipad: Auto-navigates to /signer/{id}?fullscreen=1 when assignment detected
FRONTEND E2E: PC sends repair → iPad auto-navigates to /signer/{id}?fullscreen=1 within ~3-6 seconds
FRONTEND E2E: iPad signs (checkbox + signature + validate) → 'Merci!' screen displayed
FRONTEND E2E: After signature success, iPad auto-returns to /ipad after ~5 seconds
FRONTEND E2E: ipad_state is released after signature (GET /api/ipad/current returns null)
FRONTEND /signer: Signature page loads with conditions, checkbox, client info, signature canvas
FRONTEND /signer: Validate button disabled until checkbox checked AND signature drawn
FRONTEND /signer?fullscreen=1: Kiosk mode with 'Activer le plein écran' button
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: iPad Terminal Sync feature fully implemented and tested: 1) PC /reparations page has iPad status indicator (online/offline) and 3 buttons per repair (Envoyer sur l'iPad, Ouvrir ici, Lock). 2) iPad /ipad page polls every 3s and sends heartbeat every 8s. 3) When PC assigns a repair, iPad auto-navigates to /signer/{id}?fullscreen=1. 4) After signature, iPad auto-returns to /ipad after 5s. 5) Backend auto-releases iPad state after signature. 6) TTL 30 min for stale assignments. All 5 new /api/ipad/* endpoints tested and working.
